betterdisenchanter.catalyst.none.title: No Catalyst
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.none.desc: Recovers 1st enchantment onto an enchanted book. The item is consumed.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.emerald: Extract 2 random enchantments and consume the item.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.diamond: Extract 1st enchantment + 2 random enchantments and consume the item.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.ender_pearl: Extract 1 random enchantment, keep item but damage it by 500.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.heart_of_the: Extract all enchantments with level -1, and consume the item.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.amethyst_sha: Extract 1st enchantment and keep the item intact.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.nether_star: Extract all enchantments and keep the item intact.
betterdisenchanter.catalyst.experience_b: Extract all max-level enchantments and consume the item.
